## Recent Decisions
## Recent Decisions
- #81/#83: `OptionsProvider` trait unifies CLI args and TOML tables
- #81/#83: `config.rs` moved to library crate (`pub mod config`) so tests call in-process
- #81/#83: TOML config only loaded via explicit `--config`; no auto-discovery
- #87: solver-specific opts resolved by `PipelineStage` caller, not inside `solve()`
- #87: `[stage.sa]` / `[stage.ga]` nested TOML sub-tables; wrong sub-table = hard error
- Issue #131 revised: TypeScript TSPLIB parser dropped; parsing stays in Rust/WASM via new `parse` export
- `parse` returns empty strings for name/comment/distance-type when input is JSON (not TSPLIB)
- TSPLIB names/comments are lowercased by the Rust parser (`read_from_str` at tsplib.rs:244/249)
- `DistanceType` has exactly 2 variants: `Euc2D` → `"EUC_2D"`, `Geo` → `"GEO"`
- JS bindings regenerated from release WASM via `npx jco transpile` (no extra flags — shim is default-on)
